messages:
maya: Heads-up — Synergia Health forwarded a formal request to onboard a customer-specific summarization model for discharge notes. They want PHI support, high fidelity on medication lists, and a custom taxonomy for procedure codes. They asked for a timeline and a safety checklist. @liam can you pick this up?
liam: on it. Do we have the intake form from the rep? I need sample data size and label schema.
maya: rep uploaded a redacted sample bundle (6000 notes) and a short spec — shared link: https://files.redwood/synergia/onboard. They want a 2-week pilot cadence, plus a quantized 8-bit deploy for Dedicated.
sarah: tagging safety — PHI + meds is medium-high risk. We'll need negation checks, hallucination evals, and extraction recall targets. Can we get the exact PII types they expect to surface vs strip? :lock:
liam: sample bundle looks like discharge + medlist. I'll pull out a few edge cases. Quick question: are they expecting us to host in their VPC (Private) or Dedicated? Rep said they'd prefer Private but open to Dedicated short-term.
maya: salesperson said Private long-term; pilot on Dedicated is fine. They require SOC2 + KMS integration either way.
devon: from FR side — renewal looks green but this onboarding is a gating factor for expansion. If we stall safety checks we risk delaying their Dedicated commit. Suggest we treat as high priority.
liam: action plan proposal: 1) data intake and schema sign-off (2 business days), 2) produce baseline evals (3 days), 3) safety mitigations + prompt engineering and checks (4 days), 4) pilot deploy on Dedicated + smoke tests (3 days). Total ~12 business days.
sarah: agree but reserve extra time for PHI edge cases. Also need an adversarial test set for hallucination/regression. I'll prepare the eval spec.
maya: ok please include these checklist items in the customer doc: KMS config, access control matrix, redaction policy, allowed output fields, and monitoring hooks.
liam: drafted a minimal config block for Dedicated deploy — can you review @sarah?
liam: ```
model: synergia-summarizer-v1
quantization: 8bit
kms_key: projects/redwood/keys/synergia-kms
vpc_peering: true
retention_days: 30
metrics: [latency_p50, token_cost, hallucination_rate]
```
sarah: looks good. Add a checkbox for token scrubbing in logs and a toggle for auto-redaction on PHI tokens. Also require alerting for hallucination_rate > 0.8% over a 24h window.
liam: noted. I'll add automated prompt-based checks and a post-generation NER pass for PHI suppression.
onboard-bot: intake-form received and assigned — ticket CS-4321 created. ETA fields populated.
maya: CS-4321 in our tracker now. @devon can you flag this for renewal team as a dependency?
devon: flagged. I'll add a risk note to the account: onboarding timeline impacts Dedicated commit.
maya: next steps: liam to confirm the schema (by EOD TOM), sarah to share adversarial eval template (tomorrow morning), and I will schedule a kickoff with Synergia for Thu 10am PT.
liam: confirming — will post schema PR in the ticket.
sarah: will share eval doc and a short checklist for the customer to sign off on masking rules.
maya: thanks all. Keeping this high priority. :thumbsup: If anything blocks, ping #eng-ml with CS-4321 in the thread.
